text:
Alex: Quick check — model-catalog launch next week. We have three open models still gated: Orbit-3B, Meridian7B, EchoLite. Who's owning licensing + perf profile for Orbit-3B? @Eva (legal) I think Orbit has a NC clause in the manifest.
Eva (legal): I pulled the license. It's CC-BY-NC-4.0 in the repo. Need confirmation from model owner on allowed hosted usage. Can someone drop the model artifact link?
Maria: I can own Orbit perf profiling. Jamal, can infra help with quantization/throughput runs?
Jamal: Yep. I'll provision a staging pool. Suggest a 50rps canary for 1hr to gather latency p50/p95 and KV cache behavior. @deploy-bot can you queue that? :calendar:
deploy-bot: scheduled canary job: staging/orbit-3b/canary-173872 queued for 2025-06-06T10:00:00Z. Job id: canary-173872-01
Sophie: FYI Meridian7B had a tokenizer mismatch in intake. I updated the manifest and pushed a fix. Snippet:
```
model: meridian-7b
tokenizer: huggingface/meridian-tokenizer-v2
manifest_version: 2
```
Sophie: Also left a note on the intake PR explaining the change.
Alex: Thanks. Action items: Maria — run perf runs and upload profile to /catalog/profiles/orbit-3b.json by EOD tomorrow. Jamal — book canary and confirm GPU counts. Eva — confirm license interpretation by EOD; if not cleared, we mark Orbit as Dedicated-only.
Maria: +1. Quick Q: do we want an int8 prof (smaller mem/cost) or fp16 as baseline? Int8 may shift outputs; need an eval set to verify quality.
Kevin: I can run evals. Which evals should I use? I can wire into the CI: https://git.internal/reviews/1234
Maria: Use eval sets: ["safety-suite-v2", "api-instructions", "long-context-consistency"]. Start with fp16 baseline then int8 sweep.
Eva (legal): Reading license: NC means non-commercial. Hosted public API might count as commercial depending on customer usage. I'll escalate to licensing counsel and DM the model owner. If counsel requires more restrictions we'll include a note in the catalog UI and set availability flags.
Alex: Timeline: if license ok by EOD we proceed with hosted canary Thurs. If not, mark as Dedicated/private and update catalog UI and onboarding checklist. I'll open a tracking ticket.
Sophie: There's a small CR for the manifest change, @Maria can you review? Link: https://git.internal/pr/5678
Maria: Reviewing now. If tests pass I'll merge and trigger perf runs.
Jamal: I'll post infra sizing in the ticket once I confirm GPU types: likely 1x A100S per replica, 3 replicas for canary to simulate burst. Will confirm by EOD.
Kevin: Ran a quick smoke eval locally — tokenizer fix looks good. I'll run full eval after Maria uploads baseline.
Alex: Great. Keeping this thread as async status. Please ping here when you upload the profile or get +1 from @Eva. :thumbsup:
Eva (legal): Will update here after counsel call (ETA 4pm PT).
Maria: Uploaded initial fp16 profile: /catalog/profiles/orbit-3b-fp16-173872.json — starting int8 sweep now.
Jamal: Canary booked for 2025-06-06T10:00Z, staging cluster green. I set autoscale min=2 max=10 for the window.
Alex: Awesome — thanks everyone. We'll reconvene if any blocker appears.
